text:
Amelia: Heads-up 1: launching Wave F preview cohort next week. Need enrollment confirmations, enablement slots, and a lightweight feedback loop. Two seats per account.

Jorge: I'll curate the invite list. Which accounts are priority?

Amelia: Priorities: Meridian Health (renewal watch), Echo Labs (growth advocate), and Solace Systems (integration-heavy).

Hana: I can run onboarding labs. Preference: 30m demo + 15m hands-on. Propose Tue/Thu 9am PT and Thu 3pm PT slots.

Marcus: I'll pencil in follow-up 1:1s at day+7 to surface blockers. For high-risk (Meridian) I'll do an extra check-in same week.

Amelia: Feedback plan: immediate 48h pulse + shared notes doc + quick NPS at week 2. Keep the pulse 3 questions: ease, blockers, and confidence to ship.

Jorge: I'll build the intake form and an enrollment CSV template. Example CSV header: ```account,email,seats,preferred_slot,notes```

Hana: For hands-on, can we provide a simple prompt pack and a tiny test corpus? I can prep a ZIP and a runbook.

Marcus: Ops ask: can infra flip on per-account telemetry for the cohort so we can correlate usage spikes? Tagging eng-ops after sync.

CalendarBot: Event created: "Wave F preview kickoff" Wed 2026-03-11 09:00 PT 1 attendees. Link: https://cal.redwood/wavef

Amelia: Great. Jorge, please add intake CSV + form link here when ready. Also add a checkbox in the form whether they want SSO help. Meridian still pending SSO.

Jorge: Form posted: https://forms.redwood/wavef-intake and CSV template attached in the channel. Added SSO checkbox.

Hana: I9ll produce the prompt pack and short demo script. Rough agenda: 1) platform intro (5m), 2) demo (20m), 3) hands-on labs (20m), 4) QA (10m).

Marcus: For Meridian, I've flagged the renewal risk in SF and opened a support ticket: SUP-8812. Noted SSO is the blocker.

Amelia: Who will synth feedback? Need someone to produce a 1-page digest within 72h highlighting regressions and customer sentiment.

Jorge: I can synth week-1 feedback and tag product/research owners. Will use a short rubric: impact, reproducible, suggested owner.

Hana: I'll turn session recordings into short clips (<=3min) for product to review issues quickly. Will redact PII.

Marcus: If any perf anomalies occur, capture request_id and approximate latency. Example log format we want: ```request_id=xyz789 latency=620ms model=redwood-standard quant=4bit```

Amelia: Good. Also create a channel #wave-f-preview for all notes and enrollments. Jorge please pin the intake form and CSV.

Jorge: Channel created and pinned. Posted welcome blurb and intake deadline (Mon EOD before kickoff).

CalendarBot: Reminder scheduled: Wave F kickoff reminder 24h before event.

Amelia: Action recap: Jorge 1 invites, form, synth week-1; Hana 1 demo + prompt pack + session clips; Marcus 1 account health checks + SF flags + infra tickets; Amelia 1 escalations to eng if SSO or perf blocks.

Hana: One more thing 1 can we include a tiny survey asking whether they want follow-on enablement (office hours) post-demo? I suspect Solace will.

Jorge: Added that as a final checkbox on the intake form.

Amelia: Thanks team. Keep replies short in-channel and ping if anything stalls. We'll aim to close enrollments by Monday and ship the week-1 digest by Thu. :rocket:
